summary: Frontend-only smoke tests for the three new features on TeeBox (web preview, mobile viewport 390x844). All three flows PASS end-to-end: (1) Likers list on the Feed (tap round-card-like-count opens likers-sheet, tapping a liker navigates to /user/<id>, and the heart still toggles the like without opening the sheet); (2) Notification bell in Discover, Log, and Profile headers all navigate to /notifications on tap; (3) Post detail likers work for both the round (post-like-count opens sheet, post-like toggles cleanly) and per-comment (comment-like-count-<id> opens sheet, comment-like-<id> toggles cleanly). Regression: Feed still loads, feed comment composer still opens, post-detail comments render. Logged in as reese@teebox.demo/password123.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted from multiple screens/components using shadow.card/shadow.soft. Not blocking, but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow tokens applied across cards).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — RoundCard modal composer uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RoundCard.tsx:326

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow, and move pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents on the RoundCard composer KeyboardAvoidingView (RoundCard.tsx:326).
critical_code_review_comments: LikersSheet always routes to /user/<id>. Note two dynamic folders exist (app/user/[id] and app/user/[userId]) — pre-existing and not introduced by this change, but should be reconciled to avoid future ambiguity.
In post/[id].tsx, post-like-count uses disabled={!round.like_count} so tap works only when count > 0 — matches intent. Same for comment-like-count-<id> which is only rendered when like_count > 0.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo seed data (Reese's round with existing like from Kurt Hafeken; existing comments on round).
